publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In a world emphasizing self-sufficiency and inclusiv-ity, the visually impaired community faces significant challenges in everyday tasks, particularly handling currency and accessing information while shopping. According to data from the World Health Organization (WHO), the global population of visually impaired individuals is steadily increasing. Currently, there are approximately 285 million visually impaired individuals, with 39 million of them experiencing complete blindness and the remaining 217 million dealing with varying degrees of low vision. To address these obstacles, the project introduces a wearable as-sistive device featuring camera-on-glasses technology. At its core, this device includes a Currency Note Identification system that empowers visually impaired users to accurately identify currency denominations using MobileNet artificial neural network (ANN). Furthermore, it integrates Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology for reading printed text. The system captures images, wirelessly transmits them to a dedicated mobile application, and delivers real-time auditory feedback. The design emphasises affordability and user accessibility, aiming to enrich the lives of visually impaired individuals by providing confidence and independence in financial management and shopping experiences. This innovative wearable device exemplifies the transformative potential of technology to promote inclusivity and equitable access.

articleTitle: Fingerprint and Iris Based Voting System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: A biometric voting system ensures a voter's identity before allowing them to cast their ballot by using distinctive physical or behavioral traits like fingerprints, iris scans, or facial recognition .This technology aims to enhance security and prevent voter fraud by ensuring that each vote is linked to a legitimate and unique individual. However, the implementation and effectiveness of biometric voting systems can vary, and concerns about privacy and accuracy have been raised in some cases. Nowadays Voting procedures can vary by location, but generally, citizens must register to vote, present valid identification at the polling station, cast their vote in private, and their ballots are counted to determine the election outcome. Specific details and requirements can differ by country, state, or municipality.In traditional voting method the voters has to go to their respective booth that may be their native place just to cast a single vote which is time consuming. In this paper the technique aims to boost voter turnout while lowering the costs and logistical hassles associated with conventional voting procedures. The Aadhaar database has been linked by the Indian government(which include fingerprint and iris) with the EPIC(voter id that has the constituency details).This database is used for authentication of the voter.Image segmentation, normalization, feature extraction, and matching are used to create an eye's iris template. All of these steps are crucial to getting an iris signature. In order to acquire the parameters for the iris circle, we first took an image and applied the Hough transform. The process of normalizing is used to produce a rectangular, dimensionless iris picture after segmentation has been used to create the segmented iris image and located the iris' borders. Finally, In order to create an iris signature, the phase data from the iris is extracted using a 2D Gabor filter. For matching, the Hamming distance is employed. We utilized the MATLAB framework to code this project.

articleTitle: Modern Day Business Development Using AI and ML
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is a part machine language. Both are the result of intelligence of human. articleTitle: Design of a Method Using Machine Learning Techniques for the Maintenance and Diagnosis of Failures in Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The increasing adoption of solar energy demands efficient maintenance strategies to ensure optimal performance and longevity of solar panel installations. This paper proposes a novel method leveraging machine learning techniques for the proactive maintenance and accurate diagnosis of failures in solar panels. The objective is to enhance the reliability and efficiency of solar energy systems while minimizing downtime and operational costs. The proposed method aims to empower solar panel operators with a proactive and intelligent maintenance system, allowing them to address potential issues before they escalate. By minimizing downtime and optimizing performance, this approach contributes to the sustainability and economic viability of solar energy installations. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through experimental results and comparisons with traditional maintenance approaches.

articleTitle: Analysis of Body Language and Detecting State of Mind using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research deals with the analysis and detection of current mental state including feelings, emotions and mental processes from body language signs, such as analysis of personality traits, psychological states, mental health monitoring, human-computer interaction and lie detection. In this study, we discovered this new approach to classify a person's current mental state through convolutional neural networks (CNN) based on the analysis of eye, mouth and hand positions. We use extensive data to train and evaluate our model, which includes video recordings and images that record various human activities and emotions. Pre-processing techniques including normalization and scaling are used to improve model reliability. We use a CNN architecture that is optimized for feature extraction from facial and hand movements and uses both spatial and temporal information from the input data. By extracting the main features of the eyes, mouth and hand positions and movements, we try to capture subtle clues that indicate different emotional states such as happiness, sadness etc., as well as cognitive processes such as thinking, imagining and creating. Experimental results show promising classification accuracy for detecting different mental states, with better performance than basic methods. Our approach provides valuable insights into the complex interplay between body language and mental states, contributing to the understanding of human behaviour. The proposed method has significant potential for real-world applications, including Psychological and behaviour analysis, mental health assessment, personal user interfaces etc. This proposed model is simply an artificial intelligence based psychologist.

articleTitle: Inclusion of Cyber Security Dimension for a Safe, Secure and Trusted E-waste Disposal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: E-waste has become a global phenomenon and the humongous volume of e-waste generated and disposed every day is getting worser every day. Its impact on sustainable growth is a serious matter of concern and several initiatives are taken by several organizations to control the danger of e-waste. However, the safe disposal of e-waste predominantly focus on the environmental aspect and minimal attention is provided to the data inside the devices and their possible cyber implications. Considering the enormous potential of Artificial Intelligence and the ability of data recovery tools that are available for all, the implications of improper e-waste can be severe and can even be life changing in some situations. Adoption of Cyber hygiene in disposal of e-wastes needs to be adopted not only by critical and sensitive organizations but also by all electronic gadget users. In this work, a detailed study is made on the potential challenges that careless disposal of electronic devices could bring and also discusses on the proactive mechanisms that needs to be followed to prevent the potential cyber threats.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Stress Detection Using Physiological Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Stress is a physiological and psychological response to perceived threats or challenges, triggering the body's “fight-or-flight” mechanism. Common reasons for stress are work pressure, problems with relationships and money issues. Stress can lead to many bad things like long-lasting sicknesses (such as diabetes or heart trouble), mental health problems (like worry and sadness) dangerous diseases and other medical issues which affects our wellbeing in the long term. Stress must be identified at early stages to prevent these negative effects on the health. The existing models use logistic regression, knearest neighbour and Naive Bayes methods. But they could do much better by using more complicated systems like random forest or support vector machine too. Better accuracy of models can be achieved by choosing and changing some key features, using methods like Recurrent Feature Elimination, Filter methods. Doing this can aid in living well and make unique solutions to alleviate stress.

articleTitle: Finding of DDoS Attack in IoT-Based Networks Using Ensemble Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Ensemble techniques could find DDoS attacks more quickly in IoT. A more dependable and precise detection system can be achieved by integrating the most advantageous attributes of XGBoost and Random Forest. This ensures that Internet of Things systems remain operational. Internet of Things (IoT) systems are significantly compromised regarding security and dependability by Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) assaults. Ensemble approaches, which utilize multiple machine learning models to generate predictions, appear to be a viable method for facilitating the detection of DDoS attacks in such contexts. Conventional defenses against these everevolving attacks prove inadequate when applied to a singular method. It emphasizes Random Forest and XGBoost. The accuracy of the proposed ensemble in detecting distributed denial of service attacks initiated by Internet of Things devices is 99%. The findings demonstrate how ensemble methodologies can enhance the precision and resilience of DDoS attack detection in Internet of Things systems against adversarial assaults.

articleTitle: Efficient Workload Distribution for Sustainable Server Utilization in Cloud Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Cloud service providers offer flexible infrastructure scaling options, allowing users to adjust resources based on their requirements and pay only for what they use. This paper proposes an approach to efficiently distribute workloads across host machines within a data center environment. This work proposes the concept of skewness as a measure of server utilization, identifying underutilized servers. When a server is found to be underused, its workload is redistributed to other host machines, enabling the underutilized server to be idled and potentially shut down. This strategy not only optimizes server utilization but also contributes to green computing initiatives by reducing power consumption and carbon footprint. Through Simulation, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in achieving both scalability and sustainability in cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: Enhanced Single Remote Sensing Image Dehazing via Vision Transformer with Silencing Map Transmission and advanced Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: - This research provides an improved single remote sensing picture dehazing method using sophisticated image processing techniques and Vision Transformer with Silencing Map Transmission. The dehazing output generation, morphological analysis, dark channel prior, silencing map transmission, recurrent neural networks (RNN), and input image processing are some of the components that are included in the suggested method. The objective is to far outperform current techniques in terms of dehazed image quality. The initial action in the process is getting ready the input image, after which morphological analysis is performed to determine the properties of the haze. The key characteristics of the haze are retrieved by using the dark channel before. Transmitting silencing maps improves our comprehension of scene depth, which is important for precise dehazing. RNN is used to learn from sequential data and propagate information effectively. Clearer and more aesthetically pleasing photos are produced by the dehazing output, which is generated based on the learned attributes. Mean Squared Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), and Time of Execution (TOE) are among the metrics used to assess the efficacy of the suggested approach. The supremacy of the suggested strategy is shown in contrast to current approaches. The trial results demonstrate considerable improvements in PSNR, SSIM, and TOE measures across a variety of test images. In particular, the suggested approach outperforms current methods in terms of PSNR improvements of up to 4.23 dB and TOE reductions of up to 2.58 seconds. To sum up, the enhanced single remote sensing picture dehazing approach that has been described provides significant improvements in both image quality and processing efficiency. As such, it is a promising solution that might be used for a variety of remote sensing applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent Energy Management Energy Storage Systems Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: A nevertheless-emerging generation called cloud computing permits customers to pay for services on a usage-based foundation. Internet-primarily based IT offerings are supplied through cloud computing, at the same time as virtualization enables the availability of PC sources. The muse of cloud computing is the information center, which is made up of networked computers, cables, electricity components, and different components that host and shop corporate records. With cloud facts centers, high overall performance has continually been the most critical concern, yet it compromises strength utilization. The key hassle is to lessen power consumption at the same time as preserving provider nice and performance a good way to stability device performance and strength intake. A detailed grasp of strength use styles within the cloud environment is needed for our suggested technique. We look at power consumption tendencies and reveal how, through the use of the right optimization standards based on our strength intake models, we can keep more strength in cloud records facilities. All through the prediction section, tablet optimization, which has a 97 percent accuracy rate, permits this era to provide extra correct future price forecasts.

articleTitle: Trailblazing Strategies for Solar Panel Maintenance: Employing VGG19 for Early Detection of Damage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This work investigates the development and evaluation of a deep learning algorithm for the early detection of surface contaminants and damage on solar panels, including dust, snow, bird droppings, physical damage, and electrical damage. The collection consists of a total of eighty- seven photographs, which are divided into six categories: dusty, clean, bird drop, electrical damage, physical damage, and snow-covered. The study investigates the efficacy of the transfer learning model in accurately identifying these photographs by utilizing and gaining access to the VGG 19 model. The early detection of such issues is crucial for optimizing solar panel efficiency, reducing social maintenance expenses, and minimizing resource use. The proposed methodology utilizes state-of-the-art Deep learning algorithms to analyze photos and accurately assign them to their respective categories. The findings demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed methodology in accurately identifying and categorizing surface issues on solar panels, hence resulting in enhanced energy production and environmental sustainability. The compiled findings demonstrate a notable accuracy and precision level of 92.7%.

articleTitle: Automatic Volume Control Using Image Processing and Deep Learning Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to automatic volume control using image processing and deep learning techniques. The ability to automatically adjust volume levels based on environmental factors and user preferences has significant implications for various audio applications, including teleconferencing systems, smart devices, and public address systems. By combining image processing algorithms with deep learning models, this paper aims to develop a robust and adaptive volume control system capable of accurately adjusting audio levels in real-time. The paper discusses the theoretical foundations, technical implementation, experimental results, and potential applications of the proposed automatic volume control system.

articleTitle: IoT Cryptography: A Secure Communication Framework for the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: IoT is a lightning-fast technology that uses clever objects or stuff that speak uncomplicatedly to the work of our daily lives. Smart homes, wearables, connected automobiles, vibrant urban communities; savvy retail, agribusiness, healthcare, and other areas are some of the most well-known applications of IoT. This document provides an overview of IoT Crypto a safe platform Internet of Things communication. Typically, they have elements from Internet of Things (IoT), such as the device functionality they need, the requirement to restrict the amount of information sent, and the ability to connect to the Internet. With real business relationships in mind, Innovative lightweight authentication setup and trust concepts are provided by IoT-Crypto. Include a secure communication protocol that only makes use of one DTLS connection that is encrypted. This article discusses and presents the unique components and nuanced execution details of IoT crypto in terms of essentially equivalent arrangements. Post-implementation testing and analysis of the IoT encrypted network have proven its accuracy and safety. Additionally, a test network was conducted to determine if the BLE IPSP profile and coding standards are suitable for IoT. Based on these results, the significance of future research was discussed. The IoT paradigm and communication protocols are introduced at the outset of this work and then compare countermeasures for a few security vulnerabilities at each tier of the IoT model to protect such a large and diverse company.

articleTitle: Image Insight - Transforming Images Into Narratives for Seamless Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research presents Image Insight, a ground-breaking solution merging image recognition with text-to-speech and AI chatbot functionalities. By leveraging Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models for bird and fruit recognition, Image Insight delivers comprehensive insights into image content. Its future applications extend to cutting-edge technologies like smart lenses, offering real-time audio descriptions for enhanced situational awareness. With a user-friendly interface, Image Insight promises innovative solutions across diverse domains, transforming how we interact with visual information.

articleTitle: Enhancing Intrusion Detection with Advanced Feature Extraction Through Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In this paper, the effectiveness of various ML and DL algorithms was investigated on the BotNeTloT-L01 dataset obtained from Kaggle., a comprehensive collection of IoT device traffic data. Initially., five ML classifiers., namely Random Forest, XGBoost, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, and Extra Trees Classifier, along with an Artificial Neural Network (ANN), were employed to perform binary classification tasks on the dataset using all available features. Subsequently, feature extraction techniques, including ANOVA F-Test, Mutual Information, Recursive Feature Elimination, and Permutation Importance were explored to identify the best features in the dataset. After feature extraction, the same ML and DL algorithms were reapplied, and their performance was evaluated. Results demonstrated that feature extraction techniques significantly enhanced classification accuracy across all models, indicating the importance of feature selection in improving predictive performance. This work contributes to the advancement of IoT device security by providing insights into effective classification methods and feature selection strategies for detecting botnet attacks in IoT networks.

articleTitle: Assessment of Health Behaviors in Coronary Artery Disease with Medical and Surgical Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The things a person does to keep up a healthy lifestyle are known as health behaviours. They include maintaining a nutritious diet, engaging in physical activity, maintaining mental well-being, and engaging in behaviours that raise the risk of illness. Lifestyle modifications, excessive alcohol use, smoking, inactivity, stress, depression, and so forth are examples of these behaviours. A healthy lifestyle can help prevent Coronary Artery Disease (CAD), which is mostly related to lifestyle choices. People may adopt unhealthy lifestyles as a result of their fast-paced, modern existence. It is crucial to adopt any health-related behaviours during adolescence and early adulthood since they will carry over into maturity. This study evaluates health-related behaviours in patients receiving both medication and surgical therapy for coronary artery disease. Using the purposive sample technique, 60 samples were chosen for this assessment: 30 patients receiving medicinal treatment and 30 patients receiving surgical treatment. Each customer takes twenty minutes to complete. For additional data analysis, the gathered data were coded and imported into Excel. For data analysis, both inferential and descriptive statistics were employed.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Road Accident Reporting System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: An accident is an unpredictable event. Nowadays, there is increasing in number of deaths during road accidents. According to the case study 2021, In Haryana, 969 people have died and several vehicles involved in accidents are 570. The major problem that is faced during accidents is the emergency facilities for the injured person to save him. This research paper proposes to decrease the number of deaths by road accidents using IOT. In this paper for implementation accelerometer sensors, GPS modules, GSM models, etc. are used. The prototype works by informing to victim's relative and nearby hospitals and police stationsto arrive to the spot of an accident on time as soon as much as feasible to save the victim.

articleTitle: Fault Detection In PCB Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The detection of PCB faults has been conducted in the last few years however, they were sadly ineffective in classifying defects. Finding PCB flaws is important to ensure the dependability of digital equipment. In this observation, we introduce an advanced approach for PCB fault identity and class that uses system-gaining knowledge of approaches, maximum, especially the YOLOv5 algorithm. The attention of the observer is on spotting numerous sorts of PCB flaws, which include spurs, spurious copper, mouse bites, lacking holes, byte abnormalities, and open circuits. The YOLOv5 technique, which is famous for its effectiveness in real-time item identity, is applied to teach a resilient version that may perceive and categorize exceptional forms of PCB defects. Google Colaboratory is used for the implementation, imparting cooperative and resource-wealthy sur- roundings for easy version construction and experimentation. By supplying a radical answer for PCB illness detection and categorization, our cautioned approach allows us to enhance the great and dependability of manufacturing. It allows for a greater nuanced understanding of PCB issues by addressing several flaws, which finally outcomes in greater diagnostic competencies and optimized manufacturing processes.

articleTitle: A Recent Survey on AI Enabled Practices for Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Precision farming, often known as smart agriculture, is gaining a lot of attention due to its potential to change the agricultural industry. The application of artificial intelligence (AI) in smart agriculture has been shown to increase sustainability, resource management, and productivity. This report presents the findings from a recent survey of AI-supported smart agriculture techniques. With the growing global population and ongoing environmental issues, there is a growing need for sustainable and efficient farming methods. Artificial intelligence (AI), which has the potential to be a game-changing technology, might significantly change farming operations. The employment of several artificial intelligence (AI) tools, including machine learning, computer vision, robots, and the Internet of Things (IoT), in agriculture is examined in this survey. Analyzing real-world case studies demonstrates the effective use of AI in crop management, disease detection, and resource optimization. The limitations and issues of using AI in agriculture are also discussed in the paper. The results provide useful information for scholars, policymakers, and other interested parties who want to make the most of AI's potential to support clever and sustainable agricultural methods.

articleTitle: Heart Health Forecasting with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research study explores the field of machine learning-based heart health forecasting. Through the integration of datasets sourced from the UCI Machine Learning Repository and Kaggle, we amalgamated a comprehensive dataset comprising 14 columns and 1025 observations. Employing a meticulous preprocessing regimen, we ensured data integrity by eliminating null values, conducting one-hot encoding for categorical variables, and normalizing the dataset. Seven well-known machine learning models were assessed in this study. Strict evaluation metrics were used on these models, including precision, sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. Our research clarifies the subtleties of each model's performance and offers insights into its suitability and effectiveness for heart health forecasting.

articleTitle: Streamlining Livestock Surveillance: YOLOv8 Approach to Cattle Body Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research paper introduces an innovative approach to optimize livestock surveillance by employing YOLOv8 for cattle body segmentation. The study attained a mAP(50), mean Average Precision of 0.598 and 0.464 and mAP(50-95) on a dataset comprising 704 images. Preceding model training, extensive preprocessing and image augmentation techniques were implemented, resulting in a dataset of 1476 training, 171 validation, and 71 testing images. The developed model demonstrates considerable promise in enabling real-time mon-itoring of cattle and their health status. Additionally, to enhance its suitability for edge computing environments, quantization-aware training (QAT) abd weight compression techniques were employed, ensuring efficient deployment on resource-constrained devices. The results highlight the effectiveness and practicality of employing YOLOv8-based segmentation for livestock surveillance, with notable implications for precision agriculture and animal welfare. However, further enhancements are warranted, particularly in achieving higher mAP scores across a broader range of Intersection over Union (IoU) thresholds, to fully address the segmentation challenges in this domain.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition for Phrase Interpretation: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Gesture recognition holds paramount significance in facilitating communication for individuals utilizing sign language to convey phrases and expressions. We present an innovative approach to gesture recognition in this article tailored for interpreting hand signs to derive meaningful phrases, such as “I love you,” “please,” “sorry,” and “goodbye.” Our proposed methodology integrates a multi-box detector (SSD) with dynamic hand gesture analysis to achieve real-time and accurate recognition of hand signs across various languages and cultural contexts. By harnessing the power of deep learning SSD for object detection, our system ensures swift responses while maintaining precision. Additionally, the incorporation of dynamic hand gesture analysis techniques enhances the system's adaptability to diverse sign styles and linguistic nuances, thus fostering better communication access. By means of meticulous experimentation, we establish the effectiveness of our methodology in precisely identifying and deciphering real-time sign language gestures, attaining noteworthy results in terms of both speed and accuracy. This study enhances assistive technology for hard-of-hearing and deaf communities, thereby promoting accessibility and inclusiveness in communication environments that are accommodated to the linguistic requirements of a variety of individuals.

articleTitle: An asymmetric cryptosystem based on generalized singular value decomposition with QZ modulation, using Fourier domain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In this paper, a cryptosystem with an asymmetric approach and using Fourier transform is presented. The presented scheme is based on two matrix algorithms namely generalized singular value decomposition (GSVD) and QZ algorithm. Random phase masks (RPM) used in the cryptosystem as encryptions keys while the keys generated by QZ modulation and GSVD are treated as private keys. The decryption of image is possible only using the correct decryptions keys. It is difficult to retrieve the plaintext image information if any one of the private keys is missing. Simulation results obtained using MATLAB(R2022a) confirm the validity of the cryptosystem by evaluating the key sensitivity, and resilience against occlusion-, and noise attack. Value of the mean-square-error (MSE) between the original and deciphered image is evaluated to confirm the system's efficacy.

articleTitle: CHURN FORECASTING USING DEEP LJEARNING MODEL
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In the upcoming generation, people seem to be in increasing demand for the telecom sector for its products and services, and the market for the telecommunication industry is predicted to grow at a very high pace. The telecom market is modifying based on innovations and developments worldwide. For the extension and advancement of the telecommunication market, customers and their loyalty play a vital role. In this competitive world, telecommunication companies can firm their ground by building trust with customers, along with fulfilling their expectations to maintain loyalty towards them. Making the old customers stay and gaining new customers is also a crucial role for the growth of a market. But in today's time, the number of churns is high in the telecommunication industry. These churns depend on many reasons like high customer effort, ineffective marketing, or better offers from competitors. Thus, an effective way to distinguish churn from a regular customer is needed. Without any genuine analysis, the telecom industry will suffer from the loss of its customers, which the industry cannot bear. Unlike most of the research, we have used Multi-layered perceptron (MLP), for better prediction of churns by first understanding the features of the dataset and which features are more crucial in predicting the churn.

articleTitle: An Approach to Design a Smart Mining Helmet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The mining industry is one of the most important and heavily relied upon industries. Mining facilitates the extraction of naturally occurring resources from the Earth's surface, encompassing vital elements like iron, gold, diamonds, coal, and a diverse array of minerals crucial for sustaining and advancing the economy. There are around 12,000 miners that die in mining accidents worldwide each year. Out of this, the largest number of fatalities occur in China, which produces 35% of the world's coal but accounts for 80% of the world's coal mining fatalities. The mining accidents are more prone to the underground miners. There are many reasons for the accidents, like Gas leaks like methane and carbon monoxide, posing a threat to the miners safety. The gas leaks can also cause explosions, as there is a high chance that the gas leaked is flammable. Thus, there is a need to develop a smart mining helmet to provide the miner safety and timely assistance. Hence, the objective of this project is to extend timely and crucial assistance to the distressed miners, ensuring their rescuers at the opportune moment, safeguarding lives before it reaches a critical juncture. Our product is designed to monitor the environment around the miner and detect poisonous and flammable gas underground. The study mainly focuses on the use of IoT devices and sensors which will provide an alert during the time of a mishap. This paper presents the prototype for a smart mining helmet designed to actively engage with the miner's environment, thereby enhancing safety measures and ensuring their well-being.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Elliptic curve and Hyperelliptic Curve Cryptography Methods and an Overview of Their Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The significance of cybersecurity in today's highly technological era cannot be overstated. With the advancement of modern technologies, various security measures have been developed. However, the gap to breach that security is also widening, compelling the need for enhanced security techniques. Hyper Elliptic Curve Cryptography (HECC) distinguishes itself from previous technologies by its distinct features, including untraceability, compressibility, and notably, its finite condition and key size. This research paper investigates HECC and its improved variant, Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC), while also conducting a survey of real-world applications where ECC and HECC have been utilized.

articleTitle: EfficientNet-Based Fingerprint Presentation Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: To protect fingerprint recognition systems from spoofing attacks and maintain their reliability, fingerprint presentation attack detection (FPAD) is essential. This study looks into the efficacy of EfficientNet CNN models, namely variants B0 to B3, for FPAD tasks. The models are tested on the LivDet 2015 Digital Persona dataset. The results show that as model complexity increases from B0 to B3, accuracy improves, with EfficientNet B3 reaching the greatest accuracy of 96% on the test dataset. However, performance suffers marginally when dealing with previously unknown materials for phony fingerprints. However, performance suffers marginally when dealing with previously unknown materials for phony fingerprints. The findings demonstrate the appropriateness of EfficientNet models for FPAD applications, underlining the need to choose model variants based on computing restrictions and accuracy requirements.

articleTitle: Predicting Agricultural Crop Damage Caused by Unexpected Rainfall Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Efficient allocation of resources and timely agricultural interventions depend on the precise identification of crop loss at the field parcel level. Using recent data from 2018 to 2023, this study investigates the integration of deep learning techniques with real-time field photography to classify agricultural field parcels into those experiencing crop loss and those not. We build and assess deep learning models specifically for crop loss classification using a dataset from the Finnish Food Authority (FFA) that combines on-the-ground photos taken during field visits with comprehensive field parcel information. In this work, we use convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to examine the visual characteristics that we have extracted from field photos in order to identify the subtleties that may indicate crop health or possible loss. Our goal is to improve the model's generalization capabilities over a variety of crop types and agricultural landscapes by training it on a combination of field parcel data and corresponding photographs.

articleTitle: A Survey of Age and Gender Detector for Retail Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The development of age and gender detectors using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) stands at the forefront of computer vision research, holding significant promise for diverse applications ranging from security to marketing. This survey paper constitutes a comprehensive investigation into the state-of-the-art CNN-based age and gender detection systems. We begin by elucidating the theoretical underpinnings of CNNs, explaining their relevance to this domain, and shedding light on the architecture choices that have proven effective in this context. Subsequently, we delve into dataset considerations, exploring the significance of dataset size, diversity, and quality in training robust models. Through a meticulous analysis of various methodologies employed in model training, testing, and evaluation, this survey outlines best practices and identifies key challenges. Performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, and recall, are scrutinized to provide a holistic perspective on the strengths and limitations of CNN-based detectors. Through a meticulous analysis of various methodologies employed in model training, testing, and evaluation, this survey outlines best practices and identifies key challenges. Performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, and recall, are scrutinized to provide a holistic perspective on the strengths and limitations of CNN-based detectors. In sum, this survey paper serves as a valuable resource for researchers, engineers, and practitioners involved in age and gender detection using CNNs, facilitating a deeper understanding of the technology, its challenges, and its potential applications in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

articleTitle: Enhanced Non-Defended Website Fingerprinting Attack Model Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Onion routing (Tor) is a routing protocol that uses multiple-layer encryption to protect privacy and security for authentic users during web browsing. The website fingerprinting (WF) attack, which may be used to identify which websites a user is browsing are one of the vulnerabilities present in the Tor browser, despite its security. There are many modern and advanced attack models to build a WF attack model but in this work, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is presented considering two different scenarios Close World (CW) and Open World (OW). In CW scenario, the proposed attack model attains 98.20% accuracy on traffic traces without utilizing any defense model and when the same attack model is used in the OW scenario, it attains 97.10% accuracy. In OW scenario, the precision comes out to be 0.99 and the recall is 0.90, even in the presence of imbalanced data without any defenses. Overall, in this work, the proposed non-defended attack model can identify monitored websites with a precision of 0.99, even in the real OW scenario.

articleTitle: Single Image Dehazing Using A Tiramisu Auto- Encoder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach to address the challenge of dehazing on-road images by synthesising datasets and training advanced deep learning models. Leveraging Pix2Pix GAN and introducing a novel Tiramisu Autoencoder architecture, the research endeavours to overcome the scarcity of real-world data through data augmentation and synthesis. The Pix2Pix GAN is modified to generate realistic haze, while the Tiramisu Autoencoder is used to de-haze the images. Challenges in data collection, including the absence of on-road data and time-series data, are elucidated. The novel architecture demonstrates promising results on benchmark datasets. The research boasts advances in both data synthesis and image de-hazing.

articleTitle: Atmospheric Data Acquisition From Ballon Satellite Using LoRa Module
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: A method for real-time atmospheric data acquisition from a balloon satellite employs a LoRa module and an Arduino microcontroller to interface with sensors and control the data acquisition process. This system leverages long-range (LoRa) technology to transmit weather data wirelessly over long distances, providing real-time monitoring capabilities even in challenging environments. The observation includes the gathering of air pressure, temperature, humidity, altitude, light intensity, and precipitation. The integration of hardware components in the system offers a cost-effective and efficient solution for real-time atmospheric data acquisition, which implicates meteorological research, environmental monitoring, and disaster management. By leveraging LoRa technology, it overcomes the limitations of traditional wired systems and extends the reach of weather monitoring to previously inaccessible areas.

Author Keywords: Arduino Uno, LDR Sensor, Rain Sensor, BMP 180

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network-Based Lossless Data Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In the digital era, the exponential growth of image data across various sectors, including medical imaging, satellite imagery, and digital archives, necessitates advanced solutions for efficient storage and transmission. JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group), one of the most ubiquitous image compression standards, plays a pivotal role in managing digital image data. However, its lossy nature, which compromises image integrity for the sake of compression, is unsuitable for applications requiring precise image reproduction. This project explores the potential of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) to achieve lossless compression of JPEG images, aiming to retain image quality while reducing file size significantly. This study explores the application of RNNs for efficient image compression, aiming to leverage the temporal dependency modelling capabilities of RNNs to maintain high image quality while achieving significant reductions in file size. Traditional image compression techniques often struggle to balance compression ratio and image fidelity, especially in contexts requiring real-time processing and transmission. RNNs, known for their proficiency in handling sequential data, offer a novel approach to image compression by treating image pixels as a sequence achieved an accuracy of 95.83% when compared to CNN. This perspective allows for more sophisticated pattern recognition and prediction, potentially surpassing the limitations of conventional methods.

articleTitle: Veer Suraksha Tracking of our Soldiers with the help of GPS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This Research Mainly focuses on integration of Global Positioning System (GPS) technology into soldier tracking systems to elevate safety measures for military personnel in modern warfare. This study traces the development of GPS as a driving force behind innovative safety measures, tracing its history from its civilian beginnings to its current critical role in military operations. GPS technology optimizes mission success and protects soldiers in a variety of operational environments by giving military commanders access to real-time location data. This improves situational awareness and speeds up decision-making. The implementation of GPS in the military raises several ethical issues that are examined, including privacy and responsible use. The study adds a nuanced viewpoint to the conversation about using GPS to improve soldier safety, and it offers useful information to help military planners, legislators, and tech developers navigate the difficulties of contemporary warfare.

articleTitle: State of the art object detection: A comparative study of YOLO and ViT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: As trivial as it is for humans to identify, locate, and distinguish objects from their backgrounds and other objects, for computer systems, it is not so trivial. In Computer Science domain, the topic of Object detection addresses this issue. Object detection is one of the core tasks of computer vision, which lays the foundation for instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, panoptic segmentation etc. The last two decades have seen the tremendous evolution of object detection methods, from the Voila Jones detector to deep learning models to transformer-based models. The recent trends in the field are YOLO models and transformer-based models (such as DETR). We aim to explore object detection using YOLO and pure transformer ViT, do a comparative study, and furthermore, explore the theoretical approach of the hybrid model of YOLO and ViT.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity: A Comprehensive Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques in Detecting and Preventing Phishing Attacks with a Focus on Xgboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: With the exponential rise in internet usage, individuals are progressively sharing their personal information online, resulting in a substantial volume of sensitive data and financial transactions susceptible to cyber threats. Techniques based on artificial intelligence, like machine learning, are powerful tools used to strive against phishing attacks. This research paper presents a comprehensive investigation employing support vector machines and XG-BOOST algorithms on various distinct datasets, such as Phishing Dataset for Machine Learning, Website Phishing Dataset 1, and Website Phishing Dataset 2. The study analyzes and reports the experimental outcomes, utilizing performance metrics such as accuracy, precision-recall, and confusion matrix. The support vector machine achieves accuracy, precision, and recall values of 85, 84, and 86%, respectively, while Xgboost demonstrates values of 90, 88, and 87, respectively. In general, the Xgboost <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sup>lgorith<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup> consistently achieves more accuracy equal to 99.17 %, coupled with an impressive computation time of only 0.00894 seconds.
