articleTitle: Cybersecurity Workforce Development and Training: A Comprehensive Review on the Significance, Strategies, Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The research paper investigates the Cybersecurity Workforce Development and Training, reinforcing the critical demand for qualified professionals to mitigate increasing cyber threats. It identifies the need of niche training programs to enhance overall cybersecurity. Evaluating information from thorough literature review, the study reveals the importance of ongoing learning and adaptable training in reinforcing the cybersecurity workforce. Key observations include a deficiency in measurable training metrics and the need for organizations to strategically incorporate cybersecurity training into their risk management plans. The study concludes with actionable insights, advocating for further research to substantiate training effectiveness and promoting inclusive strategies to narrow the cybersecurity skills divide, thereby creating stronger organizational and national digital defenses.

articleTitle: Adversarial Machine Learning for Blockchain Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This paper explores the intersection of adversarial machine learning (AML) and blockchain security, presenting a comprehensive analysis of the challenges and solutions in leveraging AML techniques to protect blockchain networks. The decentralized and non-regular nature of blockchain technology exposes it to various adversarial threats, including 51% attacks, double spending, and smart contract vulnerabilities. To address these challenges, AML offers a range of techniques, such as adversarial training, generative adversarial networks (GANs), feature engineering, and robust ML models. These techniques enhance the resilience of blockchain systems against adversarial attacks and safeguard sensitive data. However, implementing ML models in blockchain environments presents challenges, including scalability and cross-chain compatibility. The paper discusses these challenges and proposes solutions to overcome them, emphasizing the importance of integrating AML into blockchain security frameworks. Overall, the paper highlights the potential of AML in enhancing the security of blockchain networks and mitigating the evolving threats posed by malicious actors.

articleTitle: Addressing Class Imbalance in Diabetic Retinopathy Segmentation: A Weighted Ensemble Approach with U-Net, U- Net++, and DuckNet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a prevalent condition among diabetic patients, posing a significant risk of blindness if left untreated. Early detection of DR significantly improves the chances of successful treatment. The segmentation of DR lesions in Ultra-wide optical coherence tomography angiography (UW-OCTA) fundus images presents a complex challenge due to variations in lesion sizes and shapes. Traditional diagnostic methods by ophthalmologists are time-consuming. This study addresses lesion identification in an unbalanced dataset using deep learning techniques. The customized architectures such as U-Net, U-Net++, and DuckNet are parallelly trained on the dataset, and their performance is analyzed. Furthermore, an ensemble approach is implemented to enhance overall results, resulting in an ensembled model achieving a mean Intersection over Union of 0.52003. The mean Dice Similarity Coefficient, reaching 0.63269, demonstrates the highest accuracy for the Diabetic Retinopathy Analysis Challenge (DRAC) 2022 dataset, comprising UW-OCTA images of the retina.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Techniques to Simulate Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This article explores the application of machine learning methods for modeling intrusion detection systems. We present the research findings, including the construction of a model based on decision trees and the analysis of significant factors determining network attacks. The results demonstrate high model accuracy and the potential for its use in enhancing network security. The article also delves into the specifics of the chosen dataset and data preprocessing methods used to ensure model accuracy. Additionally, possibilities for future research in the field of intrusion detection are discussed, including the utilization of other machine learning methods, analysis of new threat types, and the study of attack obfuscation methods. This study offers important practical and theoretical recommendations for information security professionals and machine learning researchers.

articleTitle: Real Time Safety Monitoring System in Coal Mines Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This article presents a safety monitoring system for coal mines using the Internet of Things (IoT). The proposed system comprises of an underground section and a ground section. NodeMCU-1 is responsible for monitoring underground conditions through various sensors, such as a methane gas sensor, an IR flame sensor, a Carbon monoxide (CO) sensor, and a temperature and humidity sensor. Then this collected data is sent by NodeMCU-1 to the ground section via a wireless connection. NodeMCU-2 is responsible for sending alert messages through Telegram based on the readings of these sensors. The ground section, which can be a mobile device or PC, monitors the information from the underground section via a web page made using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in real-time, with its server being NodeMCU-1. Additionally, Arduino UNO and RFID are incorporated into the underground system to bolster safety measures. The hardware and software for the system is designed and developed in view of the conditions in coal mines. Results are presented for safe and unsafe conditions based on the predefined threshold values of individual sensors. Threshold values are predetermined based on the actual values collected from a coal mine environment. Results indicate the proficiency of the system in detecting unsafe conditions promptly and alerting both officials and workers, facilitating swift responses. By seamlessly integrating wireless technology with an advanced alerting system, the proposed solution emerges as a smart and efficient tool to enhance safety in coal mines.

articleTitle: Strategic Innovations in Defense Systems: A Comprehensive Analysis of Emerging Technologies and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research paper mainly aims to discuss a comprehensive review of recent advancements in defense technologies with a focus on innovations that enhance military capabilities. This paper covers a wide range of areas, including artificial intelligence, cyber warfare, unmanned systems, advanced materials, and space-based technologies. The goal is to analyze the impact of these technological developments on defense strategies and their potential applications in modern warfare. This research paper offers an in-depth exploration of recent strides in defense technologies, emphasizing their transformative impact on military capabilities. Focused on cuttingedge developments across artificial intelligence, cyber warfare, unmanned systems, advanced materials, and space-based technologies, the study evaluates their implications for modern warfare strategies. Through a critical analysis of these advancements, the paper aims to contribute to the understanding of evolving defense landscapes and the potential integration of emerging technologies in defense applications. The comprehensive review encompasses not only the technical aspects but also considers the ethical, legal, and strategic dimensions associated with the deployment of advanced defense technologies. Ultimately, this paper seeks to provide a nuanced perspective on the current state of defense technology and its trajectory, guiding future research, policy considerations, and operational implementations in the defense sector.

articleTitle: Enhanced Convolutional Neural Networks for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: For women all around the world, breast cancer is a serious concern. Catching it early is like having a superhero move - it can make all the difference, turning a potentially life-threatening situation into one with a shot at successful treatment. So, finding it sooner rather than later is a real lifesaver. To evaluate the performance of the proposed model, the researchers trained and tested the model on the Breast ultrasound Images dataset. These images, meticulously prepared through resizing, normalization, and augmentation, have been widely utilized in prior studies focusing on breast cancer prediction. The study focuses on refining accuracy through the utilization of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in combination with Transfer Learning for initial improvement. Following this, the approach shifts to leveraging the potential of the Adam optimizer with the CNN and Transfer Learning architecture to further boost accuracy. The implications of this study transcend the conventional confines of traditional medical image analysis, providing a glimpse into a prospective era where intelligent algorithms harmoniously collaborate with medical professionals. This collaboration serves to elevate the benchmarks of diagnostic accuracy. With the augmentation of early detection potential, patient outcomes stand to witness marked enhancement, thus underscoring the transformative prowess embedded within the capabilities of deep learning in the domain of breast cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Approach through Artificial Intelligence Based Machine Learning for Movie Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Movies have evolved into a powerful medium for advertising and marketing, with the power to shape consumer habits and preferences. With the ability to influence consumer habits and preferences, films have developed into a potent medium for marketing and advertising. More specifically, movie reviews have the ability to affect the decisions of those who may see them. Nonetheless, customers have the difficult task of gleaning valuable insights from many evaluations and sifting through a deluge of reviews to identify the relevant and helpful ones. The grouping of many models according to performance indicators like as f1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. In a comparison of models, BERT achieves the greatest performance accuracy 90.67% with 0.88% precision, 0.92% recall, and 0.88% f1-score among a compared techniques. Research into an interpretability of DL models for sentiment analysis in movie reviews, the exploration of new feature extraction approaches, and improving model generalization across varied datasets are all potential areas for future work.

articleTitle: A Review on Ransomware Detection in Android Using Feature Selection and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In recent years, ransomware has emerged as a serious concern in android devices, disrupting users from accessing their data and extorting payments for restoration. However, it has been found that these attacks can be avoided if detected in early stages. Literature reveals that its early detection can be achieved via optimized feature selection and machine learning techniques. Thus, this paper systematically examines the research that has already been done to identify ransomware in android devices using feature selection and machine learning till date.

articleTitle: The AI Shield and Red AI Framework: Machine Learning Solutions for Cyber Threat Intelligence(CTI)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Cybersecurity is rapidly evolving, with machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) playing increasingly vital roles in bolstering threat detection, response, and proactive defense. Two prominent solutions, the AI Shield and Red AI frameworks, utilize machine learning to address Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) challenges. While AI Shield focuses on real-time monitoring and threat intelligence, Red AI employs a dedicated AI Red Team to simulate adversaries and conduct technical attacks on AI systems. Both frameworks enhance organizations' abilities to detect and respond to cyber threats proactively. However, integrating AI into cybersecurity presents challenges such as AI failures, continuous updates, and the lack of explainability. Despite these challenges, ongoing AI research will lead to the adoption of new technologies to enhance protection and safety, while threat actors continue to develop new attack capabilities. Integrating CTI into Security Operations Centers (SOCs) enhances cybersecurity by improving situational awareness, detection, prevention, response, and proactive defense. However, challenges like data overload, skills, and collaboration can hinder CTI integration into SOC operations. Overall, the AI Shield and Red AI frameworks, along with CTI integration into SOC operations, offer promising solutions for enhancing cybersecurity against evolving threats.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Learning for Detection of Radio Frequency Interference Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In order to ensure that wireless communication systems operate at their best, it's crucial to develop reliable methods for detecting RF interference. This study compares two unsupervised anomaly detection algorithms, Support Vector Data Description (SVDD) and One-Class Support Vector Machine (SVM), using a small training database. We evaluated these algorithms by detecting various types of RF interference signals, including Continuous Interference (CI), Continuous Wave Interference (CWI), and Modulated Continuous Wave Interference (MCWI). While previous works have made strides in RF interference detection, they have some limitations. For example, some methods may struggle with accurately detecting RF interference in dynamic environments or when faced with varying interference patterns. Additionally, certain algorithms may exhibit reduced performance when dealing with low signal-to-noise ratios or in the presence of complex interference sources. To address these challenges, both SVDD and One-Class SVM (OCS) algorithms are used and described the methodology for evaluating their performance. Throughout the experiments, how well SVDD and OCS could identify abnormal interference signals are measured using the precision metric. The findings revealed that employing normalization techniques like feature scaling over a range or robust normalization significantly improved the accuracy of RF interference detection. Importantly, SVDD consistently outperformed OCS in this regard.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Dynamics of Stock Market Prices during COVID 19: An Application of ARIMA Modelling U sing Python
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic had a significant effect on worldwide financial markets, resulting in unparalleled instability and unpredictability. This study demonstrates the use of the AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model in Python to predict the fluctuations in stock market values during COVID-19. The main objectives of this study are two-fold: firstly, to examine the influence of COVID-19 on stock market behavior and uncover fundamental patterns, and secondly, to construct a dependable predictive tool to assist investors and stakeholders in making well-informed decisions in these turbulent circumstances. To achieve these objectives, historical stock market data covering the pre-COVID-19 period and the subsequent phases of the pandemic have been preprocessed. After analyzing the data for any discernible trends and seasonality, an appropriate ARIMA model for the time series has been fitted. The python pro-gramming language and its powerful libraries, such as pandas, numpy, and stats models, are employed for data manipulation, visualization, and ARIMA implementation. The findings of the study offer valuable insights into the stock market's response to the pandemic and the efficacy of ARIMA in forecasting prices during such uncertain times. The results indicated that the ARIMA model demonstrates commendable performance in capturing the short-term and medium-term price dynamics. It was found that the pandemic's impact on stock prices extends beyond traditional market indicators, necessitating a data-driven approach to comprehend the market's behavior during this unprecedented period.

articleTitle: Preliminary Detection of Dementia using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Dementia can lead to a patient's memory loss and language impairment. Dementia is rising day by day and it is one of the most common reasons for deaths in recent years. It is a continuing challenge of the 21st century and an unnoticed issue that will become more concerning if negligence continues in the future, and it can also affect a large number of the population if keeps increasing at the present pace. Detecting dementia is a major and time-consuming task. To overcome this issue of dementia detection we have tried to figure out a preliminary and feasible approach to detect dementia, which takes basic attributes that can be simply tracked by using a smartwatch and general health equipment. We have taken the data from Kaggle which has 8 attributes and 3000 rows. We have analyzed the data using Machine Learning Methods and Achieved a 79% accuracy level. The study done in this paper indicates that deep learning and machine learning can be utilised to identify dementia at early stages at an affordable price range with less time consumption and can aligned with daily activities to get more accurate and precise results in the future.

articleTitle: Decentralizing Voting: Block Chain based E-Voting System Using Ethereum Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Developing a robust electronic voting system that upholds the principles of loveliness and sequestration essential in traditional voting styles, while employing the translucency and rigidity of electronic systems, has posed a patient challenge. This ongoing exploration trials to explore the operation of block chain technology as a means to produce allotted electronic voting systems. The study introduces an ingenious electronic voting model grounded on block chain, leveled at mollifying some of the failings observed in being systems. colorful block chain fabrics are assessed for their felicity in constructing such a system. Through a case study fastening on the electoral process, the paper illustrates the eventuality of allotted tally technologies in enhancing the screen and obscurity of choices. Throughout the design evolution, we remain aware of two intermediary questions Can block chain technology be effectively employed to expedite the deployment of meaningful, high- performing operations that extend distinct vantages over traditional styles? And can block chain grease the deployment of operations while maintaining respectable interpretation within being constraints? We cast to manipulate these inquiries through our exploration bid, which involves expansive testing, dissection, and iterative refinement of the proffered block chain grounded electronic voting system. By using creations in block chain technology and integrating them with established principles of advancing veracity, our end is to establish a complete result that not only meets the rigid demands of secure electronic voting but also sets a new metric for translucency, loveliness, and effectiveness in electoral processes.Through collaboration with stakeholders, policymakers, and experts in the field, we strive to ensure that our result isn't only technically sound but also ultra practical and scalable, paving the expressway for wide relinquishment and trust in electronic voting systems.

articleTitle: Enhanced VLSI Speech Enhancement Systems Utilizing Adaptive LMS Filters and Machine Learning Techniques for Echo Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The project “Enhanced VLSI Speech Enhancement Systems Utilizing Adaptive LMS Filters and Machine Learning Techniques for Echo Cancellation” integrates advanced signal processing and machine learning to improve speech quality in Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) environments. The cornerstone of this system is the innovative use of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to dynamically predict the parameters for an adaptive Least Mean Squares (LMS) filter, which is then simulated in a Verilog environment. The methodology begins in a Matlab environment, where audio processing libraries are used to collect and preprocess a vast array of audio data, creating a diverse training set. A CNN model is meticulously developed to interpret this data and forecast optimal filter settings. These predicted parameters are then translated into a hex file format, compatible with the ModelSim environment for hardware simulation. In parallel, a Verilog model of the LMS filter is crafted, designed to adapt its parameters in real-time, simulating echo cancellation within a VLSI context. The hex audio files are processed through the filter in ModelSim, with the CNN-derived parameters guiding the adaptive filtering process. Post-simulation, the output is converted back to MP3 format using a Matlab script for practical evaluation of the system's performance. The project showcases a unique synergy between software intelligence and hardware functionality, culminating in a highly adaptive system capable of real-time speech enhancement. This system not only achieves superior echo cancellation but also lays the groundwork for sophisticated, real-world VLSI applications where audio clarity is paramount.

articleTitle: YouTube Integrated Personalised Music Recommendations based on Facial Expressions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Music has a profound impact on human emotions, providing a means of expression and a source of comfort. It can reduce stress, evoke various emotions, feelings including joy, relaxation, and motivation. Thus, Music Recommendation systems play a crucial role in suggesting and tailoring music selections based on user preferences. Researchers built models which uses the Local database to provide songs to the users which is limited to a few numbers of songs. In this study a novel model is introduced by incorporating facial expression analysis into music recommendation systems. By this the emotional connection between the listener and the music is deepened. It ensures that the recommended songs align with the listener's current emotional state. These contribute to a more immersive and satisfying user experience. In this model, the image captured using webcam can be used to deduce the emotional state from facial expressions. This can be done by creating a neural network model which is an EHC CNN model. The Model can be further improved by integrating with You tube which can open up to unlimited options to the user. This model can be used to generate recommendations that can capture the user's mood, which can help users reduce the time to find right music.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Prediction Algorithms for Detecting IoT Botnet Activities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: As the prevalence of Internet of Things (IoT) products keeps increase, the need for robust security measures becomes increasingly vital. Our paper addresses this concern by conducting a detailed comparative analysis of various machine learning methods, assessing their effectiveness in detecting and predicting malicious activities associated with IoT botnets. This paper meticulously examines initial identification methods for IoT botnet operations using advanced machine learning (ML) prediction techniques. To achieve this, we utilize the CICIoT2023 Dataset, a real-world IoT dataset obtained from networks that captures diverse device interactions and communication patterns. This dataset acts as the framework for constructing and evaluating numerous machine learning techniques, including support vector machines (SVM), k-nearest neighbours (k-NN), Naive Bayes, random forest (RF), logistic regression (LR), and decision trees (DT) approaches. Performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, F1-score, ROC curve, confusion matrix, and recall are employed to gain insights into the algorithms’ capabilities in botnet detection. Furthermore, this paper delves into an examination of the trade-offs between computational complexity and detection accuracy. This analysis aids in selecting the most suitable ML techniques tailored to specific IoT security scenarios. This comparative analysis lays the groundwork for the advancement of IoT botnet discovery strategies, providing essential insights to researchers, practitioners, and industry experts working to strengthen IoT ecosystems against growing cyber threats. We anticipate that our findings will spark more conversations and developments in the sector, promoting the establishment of more robust and adaptable security measures across the IoT landscape.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Recommender System Effectiveness based on Ratings and Trust
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The technique of providing clients with individual suggestions using the collected ratings of users who are similar is called Collaborative Filtering. Several similarity measures are used to evaluate the degree of resemblance between users. The purpose of this research study is to assess how effectively rating based algorithms perform in comparison to algorithms that also take trust in to account. The paper describes the comparison of MAE results on Rating algorithm and Rating plus Trust algorithm using cosine and probabilistic similarity measures shown in fig 2 and fig 3 of Result section. It has been observed that incorporating trust into rating generates good accuracy in recommender system. A real-world dataset entitled Film Trust is used for testing and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) is used as the foundation for assessment. This comparison attempts to measure the efficacy of different similarity metrics in collaborative filtering through examining their capability to address challenges such as data thinness (sparsity) and chilly (cold) start, as well as their ability to enhance recommendation system accuracy in that setting.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Touch Free Smart Home Controlling System Based on Virtual Reality (VR) Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The Touch-Free Smart Home Controlling System based on Virtual Reality (VR) Technology represents an innovative approach to home automation, leveraging the immersive capabilities of VR to provide users with seamless and intuitive control over their smart home environment without the need for physical touch. This system integrates VR headsets with motion sensors, depth cameras, and gesture recognition technology to enable users to navigate and interact with a virtual representation of their home environment. Smart home devices such as lights, thermostats, door locks, and entertainment systems are interconnected and controlled through the VR interface, offering users a compelling and immersive way to manage their living space. The central hub acts as the backbone of the system, facilitating communication between the VR interface, sensors, and smart home devices. Performance metrics such as response time, latency, throughput, and power consumption are monitored to ensure optimal system operation. Security measures including user authentication and data encryption are implemented to protect user privacy and prevent unauthorized access. The Touch-Free Smart Home Controlling System based on VR Technology not only enhances convenience and accessibility but also represents a significant step forward in the evolution of smart home automation towards more intuitive and immersive user experiences..

articleTitle: Tree-Based Multiclass Learning Model for Physiological Stress Detection from Students Community
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In the current educational environment, prioritizing student well-being has become increasingly important, given the pervasive impact of stress on both academic achievement and mental health. This study presents a novel approach using a Tree-based Multi-label Learning Model to forecast stress factors affecting students, addressing the complexity of multiple stressors simultaneously. By incorporating Decision Tree, Random Forest, AdaBoost, and XGBoost models, a comprehensive analysis is provided. Ensemble techniques bolster predictive accuracy, ensuring robust stress prediction. Evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-score, along with considerations of time complexity, offer a thorough assessment of model performance. The inclusion of Decision Tree and Random Forest components allows for interpretability and feature importance analysis. This model represents a significant advancement in predictive modelling for student stress, leveraging techniques like DT, RF, AB, and XGB. Through a rigorous evaluation framework, it identifies and comprehends stress factors, facilitating targeted interventions and support strategies. Ultimately, this research contributes to addressing contemporary educational challenges and promoting student well-being. Notably, the Random Forest Classifier emerges as the top performer with a remarkable accuracy rate of 90%.

articleTitle: Generating Summaries of Customer Reviews: A Hybrid Model Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Online customer reviews provide researchers with the knowledge of what people think of products and services. It quickly becomes evident that it would be tedious to manually summarize all the reviews since the data is inherently unstructured. The paper suggests an automatic review sum-marization system framework through TensorFlow, leveraging advanced deep learning. The technique uses two models: RNN-LSTM(LSTM) and CopyCat. LSTM is used widely for long reviews because of its ability to grasp the idea and the attitude of the writer, ensuring that summaries convey a sentiment genuinely felt by the reviewer. Then, the task is passed to CopyCat, which utilizes several informative words for the person's annotation. Thus, the results benefit from additional context words or facts. By leveraging the strengths of these models, the system can provide concise yet meaningful summaries that reflect the true sentiments expressed in the original reviews. Additionally, this work trains the models separately on a handpicked dataset of Amazon reviews. By doing this, they learned the specific language and words used when discussing these products. This custom training enabled the models to create summaries that accurately reflect customer opinions about the items.

articleTitle: SecureSense : AI/ML Based Anomaly Detection Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Cybersecurity threats continue to proliferate, presenting an ever-growing challenge for organizations striving to safeguard their digital assets. In response to this escalating threat landscape, research in the field of anomaly detection has gained significant momentum. This paper presents an in-depth exploration of cutting-edge research in Behavior-Based Anomaly Detection Systems (BBADS), focusing on their efficacy in proactively defending against evolving threats. Drawing upon advanced behavioral analysis techniques, machine learning algorithms, and artificial intelligence methodologies, BBADS offer a promising avenue for bolstering cybersecurity resilience. Through a comprehensive review of recent studies and experimental findings, this paper elucidates the key principles underpinning BBADS and their application in real-world scenarios. Furthermore, this research delves into the nuances of model selection, highlighting the critical factors that influence the effectiveness of anomaly detection algorithms. By analyzing the performance metrics and comparative studies of various BBADS architectures, this paper provides valuable insights into the strengths and limitations of different approaches. Moreover, the paper examines the challenges inherent in the implementation of BBADS, including data privacy concerns, computational complexity, and the need for continuous model refinement. By addressing these challenges, researchers can further enhance the practical applicability of BBADS in diverse organizational settings. Through a synthesis of empirical findings and theoretical frameworks, this paper offers a holistic perspective on the state-of-the-art in Behavior-Based Anomaly Detection research. By elucidating the latest advancements and identifying avenues for future exploration, this research aims to contribute to the ongoing evolution of cybersecurity defense mechanisms, ultimately fostering a safer digital environment for organizations and individuals alike.

articleTitle: A Robust Malware Classification Approach Leveraging Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Malware detection is a critical aspect of cybersecurity, with the constant evolution of malicious software posing significant challenges to computer systems and networks. Traditional security measures often struggle to detect obfuscated malware, which employs sophisticated techniques to evade detection. This research explores the utilization of memory analysis techniques coupled with machine learning and deep learning algorithms, augmented by Explainable AI (XAI), to enhance malware detection and classification. Leveraging a well-balanced dataset specifically tailored for memory analysis, various algorithms including Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, LSTM, GRU, ANN, and hybrid models were employed for multiclass classification. Ensemble methods were also implemented to improve classification accuracy. The results demonstrate the efficacy of ensemble methods like Random Forest and XGBoost in accurately detecting obfuscated malware, with Random Forest achieving an impressive accuracy of 87.30%. Furthermore, the integration of GRU and LSTM architectures in hybrid models showed promising results, highlighting the effectiveness of combining different neural network architectures for improved performance in multiclass classification tasks. Through Explainable AI techniques such as LIME, insights into the underlying features and decision criteria influencing classification outcomes were provided, enhancing the interpretability and transparency of the models. This research contributes to advancing the field of malware detection and combating evolving cyber threats, with practical implications for real-world cybersecurity applications.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Technique For Detecting Drowsiness And Notifying Through Mails And Alarm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Drowsiness or Fatigue is the process of impairing an individual's mental and physical abilities. It can happen as a result of not getting enough sleep, extended periods of inactivity, or other factors like medication, alcohol, or clinical settings. The main consequences of being sleepy are the potential for fatalities and injuries. It distinguishes between awake and sleepy phases by analysing factors such as frame posture, eye movements, and facial expressions. Drowsiness can find using brainwave patterns, particularly alpha and theta frequencies. The current process includes OpenCV and deep learning model that helps in detecting face and eyes using 68 face land marks. If a person is drowsy then we will alert a person with the help of alarm and we will send mails to their family or friends that the person is drowsy and inform to kindly alert him, otherwise accidents may occur. The further development which we would like to do is to integrate a chatbot and that helps in keeping the person alert all the time. The current model will have good accuracy and developments to get rid of accidents. The last purpose is to beautify avenue safety and mitigate injuries due to driving force drowsiness, contributing to the general nicely-being of society. The ultimate goal is to enhance road safety and mitigate accidents caused by driver drowsiness, contributing to overall well-being of society.

articleTitle: Maximizing Efficiency in Landfill Operations Using IoT and Random Forest Algorithms for Green Revolution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to waste management that is more sustainable and eco-friendly. Important landfill factors including temperature, humidity, gas emissions, and waste accumulation may be monitored in real-time with this system, which combines the Random Forest algorithm with Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The IoT sensor has the potential to provide real-time data interchange and monitoring, while the Random Forest algorithm a machine learning approach might provide effective pattern identification and decision-making. The use of Random Forest in predictive modeling method for the creation of early warning systems that can combat potential issues such gas leaks, overfilling, and operational inefficiencies before they ever happen. Future possibilities and consequences of this technology convergence may also be covered in the paper, with an emphasis on the important factors to consider for the effective and scalable deployment of waste management systems. Privacy and security of data, development of infrastructure, cost-effectiveness, and involvement of stakeholders are all factors that may be taken into account. A performance indicator would be a prediction accuracy of more than 95% on the validation and test datasets. Wind turbines and solar panels, which produce power from waste gas, may be more easily integrated into landfill operations using this technology, significantly reducing the environmental impact of landfill operations.

articleTitle: Predictive Disease Modeling for Proactive Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The proposed progressive Disease Prediction System symbolizes an advanced fusion of technological innovation and medical expertise aimed at transforming healthcare by enabling the early identification of some of the more chronic diseases. Utilizing specialized machine learning models, this research aims to predict disease onset based on user-provided health data. The system features a user-friendly web interface, ensuring seamless interaction for data input and result visualization. Each disease prediction model, having explored various machine learning models for optimal accuracy, employs specific algorithms to ensure precision and reliability. Emphasis is placed on data privacy, ethical considerations, and compliance with healthcare regulations. The research not only contributes to efficient resource allocation and enhanced population health but also empowers individuals to proactively manage their well-being. Challenges encountered during development, such as data variability, model complexity, and regulatory compliance, were addressed with innovative solutions. The research's future scope envisions continuous growth, contributing to advancements in healthcare prognosis and fostering a proactive approach to health management.

articleTitle: Analysis And Identification of Malware Using Machine Learning with Optimized Features selections
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Electronic gadgets like laptops and smartphones are easily accessible to the people, It is attracting the interest of cyber thieves who exploit mostly through the broad availability of malicious programs as advances in technology. The increasing prevalence of malware attacks has raised the need for efficient malware detection methods. Malware is one type of program that may harm the security of a computer system. Malware is made up of unwanted, harmful opponents that attempt to hazard the security and do serious damage. As a result, malware detection and classification has become a major problem for the cybersecurity com-munity. The detection of malware consists of identifying it without knowing what it is, but malware classification involves classifying malware. Using the XGBoost algorithm to identify the importance of the feature for selection, this paper shows an effective optimized ML based approach for the identification and classification of malware. It suggests the importance of the parameter that performs best in the selection process by using RFECV techniques for the optimization of the parameters that are most effective to train the voting Ensemble of the ML models for improving the identification and classification and obtained the best accuracy 1.0 and 0.87 respectively.

articleTitle: Monitoring Hyderabad's Carbon Emission using Machine Learning for Sustainability Assessment of Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research is about the assessment of Hyderabad City to reach SDG 11 goal, SDG(Sustainable development goal)11-Goal 11 is about making cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable. Today, more than half the world's population live in cities. By 2050, an estimated 7 out of 10 people will likely live in urban areas. As Hyderabad a upcoming mega city of India possible be the IT and Financial Capital of India and also the host to Countries defence and missile research centre DRDO, was already a big city but for the last two years this city name was spoken all over the world for being the best place to start up and invest because of having a good ecosystem with good logical support and was told will be a mega city and leading world IT by the year 2030 and will be growing more till 2050, so to make the city more sustainable development this paper will assess the past carbon emissions and also predict the future trends and also be predicting some Sustainable Development aspects like future transport pollutions and future road and transportation upgrade to be made in order to make the city resilient and make it go forward in an Sustainable manner. The research utilizes the Hyderabad city data from the year 1993 to 2019 and came up with the Emission Factor and Formulae to give the Carbon Estimates and made the Carbon estimates data set from the year 2002 to 2019 for the Transport sector and also predicted the vehicles growth and the carbon estimates till the year 2030.

articleTitle: Unleashing Innovation: Experimental Evaluation of Blockchain Assisted Electronic Voting System Using Secured Authentication Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The abstract presents a concise overview of the methodology and key findings of the experimental evaluation conducted for a Blockchain Assisted Electronic Voting System (BAEVS) employing a Secured Authentication Scheme. This study focuses on the design, implementation, and assessment of the BAEVS, aiming to enhance the transparency, security, and reliability of electronic voting processes. The methodology encompasses three main stages: Prototype Development, Blockchain Platform Selection, and Smart Contract Implementation. The prototype is developed using modern web development frameworks to ensure usability and accessibility for diverse users. A suitable blockchain platform, such as Ethereum or Hyperledger Fabric, is chosen to implement the distributed ledger component, considering factors such as scalability and security. Smart contracts, developed in platform-specific languages, govern the voting process and undergo rigorous testing to ensure correctness and reliability. The experimental evaluation reveals promising results, demonstrating the effectiveness of the BAEVS in providing secure and transparent electronic voting. Overall, this study contributes to the advancement of electronic voting systems by offering insights into the design and implementation of blockchain-assisted solutions with secured authentication mechanisms.

articleTitle: An Experimental Evaluation of an Effective QR Code Based Duplicate Product Detection Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Over the span of the last few years, innovations in blockchain technology have received a great deal of attention. Currency exchange, which has a variety of applications in addition to digital money, is the subject that receives the most attention. Because of this, it may have an effect on multiple industries. Large-scale financial transactions have become more transparent and straightforward as a result of the implementation of blockchain technology. Through the utilization of blockchain technology, we are able to recognize counterfeit merchandise. When it comes to making a purchase of any kind in this day and age, the question of authenticity frequently makes an appearance. In addition, studies have shown that these aspects are essential for the expansion of the economy. In light of this, it is of the utmost importance to educate consumers about the transparency of the items in order to decrease the number of counterfeit goods. With blockchain technology, we have taken a step closer to eliminating the ever-increasing presence of false and hazardous items from the global market. This is a cause for concern. Each and every person ought to be made aware of the fact that the utilization of technology will result in a reduction in the production of merchandise that is counterfeit. Every item must be given a one-of-a-kind digital code in order to guarantee that the production and packaging processes are carried out correctly. In this research, a novel method for detecting counterfeit goods is presented. This method is referred to as the Blockchain and QR based Product Analyzer (BQRPA). It undergoes cross-validation with the traditional Classical Fake Product Identifier (CFPI) in order to determine whether or not it is effective. Within the context of the software installation process, this programme performs a scan of the product code in order to ascertain whether or not the product in question is a counterfeit.

articleTitle: RecipeLens: Revolutionizing Meal Preparation with Image-Based Ingredient Detection and Recipe Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In today's fast-paced lifestyle, the importance of preparing meals at home has significantly increased due to the high costs and time constraints associated with dining out. However, while home-cooked meals offer numerous benefits, such as cost-effectiveness and convenience, maintaining variety in one's diet is crucial to preventing culinary monotony. Contrary to common belief, creating diverse recipes does not necessarily require an extensive array of ingredients; rather, innovative combinations and techniques can transform familiar ingredients into exciting culinary experiences. This research paper introduces RecipeLens, a novel approach that combines food ingredient detection with recipe suggestions to streamline the cooking process and enhance culinary creativity. Building upon existing studies in food ingredient detection and recipe recommendation, RecipeLens integrates both functionalities into a unified platform, offering users a seamless and efficient way to discover and prepare diverse dishes using available ingredients. To expedite ingredient classification, RecipeLens employs the MobileNet_v2 model, renowned for its accuracy and efficiency in image recognition tasks. Additionally, recipe suggestions are sourced from the Food Recipe API, ensuring the validity and relevance of each recommended dish. Furthermore, RecipeLens accommodates users with limited knowledge of fruit and vegetable names, making it accessible to individuals of varying culinary expertise. Through the integration of ingredient detection and recipe recommendation, RecipeLens empowers users to unleash their culinary creativity, discover new dishes, and enjoy diverse homemade meals with ease and efficiency.

articleTitle: Eco-Friendly Production Forecasting in Industrial Pollution Control with IoT and Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Modern industrial pollution requires proactive measures to mitigate its environmental effects. This paper advances eco-friendly production forecasting using IoT and Logistic Regression (LR). Optimizing output, reducing pollution, and minimizing industrial activities' environmental imprint are goals. Industrial IoT sensors keep track of energy consumption, raw material use, and pollution in real-time. Processing and analyzing this data identifies production patterns and trends. LR is used to predict production factors and pollution levels. The model's use has several advantages. First, it provides real-time production environmental effect data. This lets firms alter production on the go, optimizing resource use and reducing emissions. The system can estimate future pollution levels based on projected production scenarios, enabling proactive pollution management and environmental compliance. LR and IoT enable sustainable industrial production. Company eco-friendly policies, waste reduction, and manufacturing efficiency may be improved by recognizing pollution drivers. This method supports global sustainability and environmental preservation. This technology is shown to revolutionize industrial pollution management, decrease ecological damage, and encourage environmentally aware production forecasting. It's a promising move toward eco-friendly production and meets the rising need for a responsible and sustainable industry.

articleTitle: Dynamic Ensemble Learning Framework Enhanced with XAI To Detect Android Malware
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The unparalleled threat posed by Android malware is the primary cause of numerous security issues on the internet. Although commendable efforts have been made to detect and classify Android malware using machine learning techniques, more dynamic learning must be explored for this purpose. The cyber community must address the detection of Android malware in smartphones to eliminate these menacing malware samples. This study presents a new approach that utilizes dynamic ensemble learning with enhanced XAI to classify and characterize Android malware samples. The CIC-AndMal2020 dataset used in this study includes 14 prominent malware categories and 191 distinguished malware families. This research demonstrates the successful application of dynamic ensemble learning, achieving an accuracy of 98.36% and the efficiency of the results is confirmed with explainable AI.

articleTitle: A Novel Post Exploitation Framework for Red Team Operations - Buzzard
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel, all-encompassing, real-time surveillance framework meticulously crafted to function as an advanced post-exploitation tool, facilitating command and control (C2) operations and named Buzzard. Its innovative design allows it to operate independently of a centralized or intermediary redirecting server, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and security. At its core, Buzzard is conceptualized as a specialized C2 Server, strategically eschewing the reliance on a central server. This is achieved through the sophisticated tunneling of local ports, which is further secured by the implementation of encrypted tunnels. This method not only significantly reduces latency, thereby ensuring swift and efficient data transmission, but also substantially elevates the security measures, safeguarding against potential vulnerabilities and threats. Through this approach, Buzzard sets a new standard in the realm of cybersecurity tools, offering a robust, secure, and highly responsive solution for managing post-exploitation activities.

articleTitle: Advancements in Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Diagnosis and Detection in 3D Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Medical imaging is an important part of modern healthcare. It helps us understand the complexities of the human body using different tools like X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans. This technology plays a pivotal role in early disease detection, empowering healthcare professionals with crucial insights. In this paper, we explore the exciting progress in 3D medical imaging, a new and improved way to see inside the human body using tools like X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans. We focus on the benefits of segmentation, which is like highlighting specific parts in the images. This helps doctors to be more accurate in identifying and understanding different body structures, making it easier to plan treatments. We also look at different ways of doing segmentation and compare how well they work. Importantly, we discuss how smart computer programs, known as machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), are crucial in this field. These clever programs help to automate and refine the segmentation process, making it faster and more efficient for healthcare professionals.

articleTitle: Detection and Characterization of Darknet Traffic Using Attention LSTM with XAI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The Darknet comprises networks and technologies prioritizing privacy and security, often linked to illicit activities involving malware and attacks on legitimate services. To combat potential Darknet misuse, it is crucial to comprehend and classify its traffic. This study delves into analyzing authentic Darknet traffic using the CIC-Darknet2020 dataset. By conducting meticulous data pre-processing, an Attention Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model is trained to identify and categorize Darknet traffic accurately. The results are remarkable, with a detection accuracy of 99.70% for Darknet traffic and 97% for classifying the nature of Darknet operations. Furthermore, the LIME technique offers transparent explanations for the model's decisions. Compared to cutting-edge methodologies, this proposed system surpasses others, showcasing the approach's efficacy in detecting and comprehending Darknet traffic.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Overview of Transformative Potential of Machine Learning and Wireless Sensor Networks in Sustainable Urban Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have become essential elements in the advancement of smart cities, enabling the collection and analysis of data in real time for a wide range of urban applications. This article provides an exhaustive examination of current developments in the application of Machine Learning (ML) techniques to WSNs for smart cities. The paper examines a wide range of applications, such as infrastructure management, urban mobility, environmental monitoring, and reinforcement and deep learning algorithms. It emphasizes the significance of each of these types of algorithms. Significant obstacles like data security, scalability, and energy efficiency are examined, in addition to possible remedies and recommendations for future studies. By means of a methodical examination of extant scholarly works, this review provides scholars, practitioners, and policymakers with significant perspectives that promote sustainable growth and innovation within smart city ecosystems.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Based Agribot for Smart Farming and farm Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The agricultural business of today is data-centered, precise, and wiser than it has ever been before. This is in contrast to the impression that some people may have about the agricultural process. Almost every sector, including “smart farming,” was rebuilt as a result of the fast rise of technology built on the Internet of Things (IoT), which shifted the industry away from statistical techniques and towards quantitative ones. These revolutionary developments are shaking up the many agricultural practices that are now in use and bringing forth new possibilities of Agribots along with a variety of obstacles. Within the context of agriculture, this article present the promise of IoT Agribot, as well as the obstacles that are expected to be encountered when integrating it with the conventional agricultural operations. This paper conduct an in-depth analysis of IoT Agribot methods related with wireless sensors that are used in smart farming and farm monitoring. The explanation of how Agribot technology assists producers throughout the many phases of agricultural production, beginning with planting and continuing through harvesting, packaging, shipping and monitoring. In addition, this paper takes into consideration the use of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) for the purpose of farm monitoring as well as other advantageous applications such as the crop yield optimization. On the basis of this comprehensive assessment, it conclude by identifying present and future trends of the IoT Agribot and highlighting prospective research problems.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Ranking using Fuzzy-Ksi for Network Intrusion Detection using a Krill Herd Optimized Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The rising frequency of cyberattacks highlights the urgent need for reliable network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). High dimensionality data present problems for existing NIDS, increasing processing complexity and inefficiency. This research presents a novel method for optimizing a feedforward neural network (FFNN) using the Krill Herd Algorithm (KHA) and the Fuzzy Kulczynski Similarity Index (KSI) for feature ranking. The major conclusions show that, when compared to benchmarks, the proposed algorithm greatly improves NIDS's performance, obtaining an accuracy of 99.5%. This study shows that the combined feature ranking and optimization strategy is better than conventional methods, advancing the development of intelligent and adaptive NIDS that can handle developing cyber threats.

articleTitle: Speaker Recognition for Hindi Language Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The work presents speaker identification using deep learning. Speaker identification is the process of identifying a speaker from the spoken utterances. The speaker recognition technology can be applied for authentication, surveillance, forensic speaker recognition, security and speaker tracking. The Text-to-speech (TTS) systems, also known as voice synthesis systems, can be implemented with artificial neural networks (ANNs). These systems produce corresponding speech outputs based on text input. ANNs are especially well suited for this task because of their capacity to produce realistic speech and learn intricate patterns. The speaker identification system was developed using deep learning for Hindi speech. The self-created database using Wave Surfer was applied to the experiment. The Mel Frequency Cepstral coefficients were applied. The comparative analysis of different speaker identification methods was also presented. The researcher can apply the research findings to develop a speaker identification system in low-resource languages.

articleTitle: Personalized Travel Itinerary Generator System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The Travel Itinerary Generator is designed to make vacation planning more efficient by considering individual preferences. By using details like destination, budget, and interests provided by users, the system creates personalized travel plans. Users can specify preferences for hotel amenities and food, and the system then recommends five hotels, two daily attractions, and dining options. Utilizing a data science pipeline that includes web scraping, data analysis, user profiling, and three recommendation algorithms (Restricted Boltzmann Machine, Alternating Least Squares, and a hybrid model), this innovative system streamlines itinerary creation while also providing valuable insights into the integration of data-driven methodologies.

articleTitle: Advancements in Meta-Learning Paradigms: A Comprehensive Exploration of Techniques for Few-Shot Learning in Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The rapid evolution of computer vision applications demands innovative approaches to address the challenges posed by limited labelled data. This study undertakes a comprehensive exploration of meta-learning paradigms, specifically focusing on their efficacy in the realm of few-shot learning. Three distinct meta-learning frameworks (MAML, Reptile and Matching networks) are scrutinised and compared to elucidate their contributions to the adaptability and generalisation capabilities of computer vision models. This research contributes valuable insights to the meta-learning discourse in computer vision, offering nuanced understandings of framework strengths and limitations and serving as a catalyst for future innovations in adaptive machine learning models. This study also compares performance of MAML, Reptile and their variants and discusses applications of FSL in computer vision. This study concludes with nuanced differences in performance with higher F1 score and accuracy in Reptile framework, having a better trade-off among recall and precision.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In our ever-evolving digital landscape, cybersecurity has emerged as a paramount concern for individuals, businesses, and governments worldwide. The proliferation of cyber threats, from insidious malware to sophisticated phishing attacks and devastating data breaches, underscores the urgent need for robust cybersecurity measures. Intelligent systems offer promising solutions by harnessing advanced technologies like artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and big data analytics. These systems play a pivotal role in fortifying cybersecurity infrastructure through advanced threat detection, automated response mechanisms, adaptive defence strategies, and enhanced security analytics.

articleTitle: Efficient Intelligent Based Compliance, Detection, Tracking, and Proximity Model for Traffic System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The Intelligent Traffic Management System (ITMS) is a cutting-edge solution designed to address multiple aspects of traffic management and safety. This advanced system incorporates various technologies to tackle issues such as helmet compliance, traffic signal violations, number plate identification, cell phone usage tracking, and proximity-based police station alerts. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, the ITMS can accurately detect and enforce helmet compliance among motorcyclists, ultimately reducing the risk of head injuries in road accidents. Furthermore, the system utilizes advanced video analytics to detect violations of traffic signals, ensuring that motorists adhere to traffic rules and regulations. Additionally, the ITMS employs automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) technology to quickly and efficiently identify vehicles with illegal or expired license plates, enabling law enforcement agencies to take appropriate action. Moreover, the system includes a cell phone usage tracking feature which uses computer vision techniques to identify drivers who are using their phones while driving, contributing to a decrease in distracted driving incidents. Lastly, by introducing proximity-based police station alerts, the ITMS enables prompt response from law enforcement agencies by automatically notifying the nearest police station in the event of a traffic violation or accident. In summary, the Intelligent Traffic Management System provides a comprehensive and holistic approach to traffic management and safety through its features of helmet compliance, traffic signal violation detection, number plate identification, cell phone usage tracking, and proximity-based police station alerts.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The hearing-impaired community in India mostly uses Indian Sign Language (ISL) which is a rich and multifaceted visual-gestural language. Bridging the gap between the users of sign language and non-users would require automatic recognition of ISL gestures. This paper introduces an original technique for ISL detection, applying deep learning methods. We propose a Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)-based architecture that takes as input live video frames of ISL gestures or any signs that we can train the data set on outputs the corresponding sign labels. Our model was trained on an extensive dataset of annotated ISL gestures and yields state-of-the-art performance in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. Additionally, we present a new ISL dataset that includes different types of movements/signs to encourage further investigation in this field. Our approach significantly enhances accessibility for DHH by recognizing individualized signs with high precision, as demonstrated in our experimental findings. We have created our dataset and trained it using the CNN algorithm, taking more than 100 images for each letter with different angles to achieve higher accuracy. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we performed extensive experimentation on our ISL dataset and contrasted it with current state-of-the-art techniques. Our experiments reveal that our approach has higher accuracy and computational efficiency than these approaches, thus proving its applicability in real-world environments.

articleTitle: An Efficient Meta-Heuristic Dimensionality LSTM Model for Dimensionality Reduction and Clustering for Attack Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Intrusion detection helps secure and monitor systems and networks for malicious activity. As technology has advanced, network systems have become more vulnerable to intrusion. More than simple firewalls and detection systems-traditional ones are required to defend against advanced persistent threats. When breaches occur, they must be addressed carefully. Modern Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), a current firewall, and an intelligent Intrusion Detection System (IDS) must be used to protect an organization's infrastructure. This paper proposed a Gaussian Meta-Heuristics Attack Classification (GMAC) for attack detection and classification. The GMAC model uses the meta-heuristics model for the clustering process. The Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) in the meta-heuristics model feature is optimized, and dimensionality reduction is performed. The GMAC model uses the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model for the deep learning model for attack detection and classification. The GMAC model's efficiency is evaluated when considering attack platforms such as KDD‘99 and NSL-KDD. The performance analysis stated that the GMAC model achieves a classification accuracy of 99%.

articleTitle: From Pixels to Insights: Harnessing Deep Learning for Accurate Plant Pathology Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The growing threat to the world's food supply from plant diseases shows that we really need better and more accurate ways to find these diseases. This research is about using advanced deep learning technology to solve this problem. The study looks at how well different models work for figuring out plant diseases. Some of the models it looks at are AlexNet, DenseNet169, Inception_v3, ResNet34, Squeezenet1_1, and VGG13. The information used includes 38 different plant diseases from the PlantVillage dataset extracted from Kaggle and also a background class from the DAGS dataset. The results show that there are small differences in performance between different types of designs and ways of training. For example, AlexNet is very accurate when it is retrained deeply, reaching 99.24% On the other hand, DenseNet169 performs very well with 99. 72% accuracy when it undergoes deep retraining. In addition to measuring accuracy, the research also includes visualization experiments to help us better understand how the models behave. The occlusion experiment shows heat maps that visually represent how different parts of an image affect the decisions made by the computer program. The saliency map experiment uses math to figure out which pixels are most important. This helps us understand how the model makes decisions. Images for certain plant diseases like Early Blight, Late Blight, and Septoria Leaf Spot are shown using AlexNet and VGG13. In summary, this study compares different deep learning models for spotting plant diseases and also gives important information about how they work. The results help choose the best models and training plans, which improves the creation of strong and trustworthy automated systems for diagnosing plant diseases. This research is an important step in bringing advanced disease detection to farming using the latest technology.

articleTitle: A Robust Anomaly Detection Framework Utilizing Feature Engineering and Ensemble Techniques with BETH Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Anomaly detection holds a critical role in cybersecurity, with the aim of identifying suspicious activities or behaviors that deviated from normal patterns. In this paper, the BPF-extended tracking honeypot (BETH) dataset is utilized, designed specifically for uncertainty and robustness benchmarking in cybersecurity. BETH consists of essential features and the target variable evil. This dataset captured modern host activity and data collected from cloud services, rendering it highly relevant for real-world deployments. Notably, BETH offered a comprehensive view of malicious behavior by incorporating both kernel-process and network logs. The study aimed to apply various machine learning algorithms, encompassing Adaboost, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, and Extra Trees Classifier, to detect anomalies in the BETH dataset. Prior to model training, preprocessing techniques were employed to handle missing values, perform feature engineering, and scale numerical features. Additionally, the performance of these algorithms was compared, and exploration into ensemble techniques stacking and voting classifiers to enhance detection accuracy. Through systematic experimentation and evaluation, the goal was to identify the most effective anomaly detection algorithms and ensemble strategies for enhancing cybersecurity measures.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Crowd Analysis and Density Estimation by Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: In an era characterized by urbanization and densely populated events, the ability to accurately analyze and estimate crowd density is paramount. From public safety measures in cities and event venues to strategies for retail optimization, understanding the flow and behavior of crowds can significantly improve decision-making processes and resource allocation. This research report delves into the realm of crowd analysis, emphasizing its significance across various sectors and highlighting contemporary techniques. At its core, the report focuses on three cutting-edge machine learning algorithms: Mobilenet SSD, Yolov4, and Mask RCNN, dissecting their capabilities and potential applications. It also acknowledges the inherent challenges, from occlusions in densely packed areas to diverse environmental influences, and offers a perspective on how modern tools, combined with data from surveillance cameras, lidar, and thermal sensors, can overcome them. The integration of these technologies into a coherent, real-time system, driven by big data analytics and cloud computing, further underscores the potential of this research. While this study is grounded in current methodologies, it also looks forward, contemplating the ethical implications and considering the integration of multimodal data fusion and privacy preservation techniques as avenues for future exploration.

articleTitle: Efficacy of Certain Nursing Interventions on Neuropathy Aching Among Patients With Diabetic Mellitus
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: By 2020, everyone will be held accountable for their health, and protecting our own health from major complications will be the first step in that direction. Diabetes is a dangerous medicinal illnesses in USA, as per the Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (CDCP). The prevalence of diabetes has sharply increased over the past 20 years universally, and is a global concern now. Aim and Objectives: To appraise the impact of a particular nurture intercession on the degree of neuropathy ache in patients with diabetes mellitus. Methodology: The efficacy of a particular nursing intervention was evaluated using a quasi-non-randomized model with control strategies. The investigation, which included 60 samples, is conducted in the diabetes inpatient section of Saveetha Medical College and Hospital in Chennai. This intervention consists of a vegan plant based food menu that is developed and given to follow for one week, as well as a contrast bath (alternating foot immersion in warm water for 180 seconds and normal icy water for sixty seconds) that was delivered in five phases totaling twenty minutes. The Galer Neuropathy Pain Scale measures the amount of neuropathy ache both before and after the test. Results and Discussion: The study's conclusions demonstrated that, in the posttest position of neuropathy pain, the evaluated mean measured to 20.27 with a Standard Deviation (SD) of 7.25, whereas the control group's average value was 28.07 with a SD of 8.07. The statistical significant variation in posttest position of neuropathy ache with guests having diabetes mellitus amid the untried and control groups at p ≤0.05, as demonstrated by the estimated “t” rate of 3.58, which is complex than the predefined value.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease Identification Using Random Forest and XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a serious and long term condition stemming from either renal disease or flawed kidney functions. Kidney cancer, known for its lethality, holds paramount importance in patient survival, necessitating early diagnosis and accurate classification. Timely intervention and suitable therapy can impede or postpone the progression of this chronic ailment to its advanced stages, where life-saving measures like dialysis or renal transplantation become imperative. The pressing challenge in current research revolves around the development of automated tools proficient in precisely identifying Chronic kidney Disease. This paper introduces the application of XGBoost and Random Forest algorithm which efficiently and effectively detect Chronic kidney disease, offering the potential to mitigate its progression and improve patient prognosis. The efficacy of classification technology is contingent upon the quality of the dataset.

articleTitle: Advancing Survey on Multi-Tenant Cloud Environments: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: This research examines cloud forensic challenges and solutions using quantitative methodologies. Major challenges in cloud forensics, including data dispersion, loss of control, multi-tenancy, and integrity/authenticity, were identified. The effectiveness of cloud forensic tools was evaluated, with Tool 2 identified as the most effective. Factors A and B were found to influence tool adoption. Emerging trends in cloud forensics, such as advancements in cloud technologies and new security threats, were explored. The study provides valuable insights for practitioners and researchers, informing decision-making in addressing challenges, selecting tools, and considering future directions in cloud forensics.

articleTitle: Authentication in Blockchain-Based IoT Devices: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm is setting the stage for a future in which many everyday objects will be networked and able to communicate with their surroundings to gather data and perform tasks automatically. Improved productivity, fresh revenue streams, and new business models are all produced by this ecosystem. Although it makes possible a massive data exchange that was formerly impossible, it presents difficulties in delivering user information securely. Because of how IoT systems are designed, protecting connected devices and networks is both extremely important and challenging.
